steps.name: Clear app cache
steps.instructions: Settings > Apps > Acme Pay > Storage > Clear cache, then reopen the app.

steps.name: Update app to latest version
steps.instructions: Open the Play Store or App Store and install the latest Acme Pay update.

steps.name: Re-link 2FA device
steps.instructions: On acme.example/security, remove the old 2FA device, then scan the new QR code in the app.

steps.name: Reset password
steps.instructions: Tap 'Forgot password' on the login screen and follow the OTP link.

steps.name: Reinstall app
steps.instructions: Uninstall Acme Pay, restart the phone, and install it again.

steps.name: Restart router
steps.instructions: Unplug the router for 30 seconds, plug it back in, and wait for the light to turn solid green.

steps.name: Switch Wi-Fi to 5 GHz band
steps.instructions: Connect to the network ending in -5G instead of the 2.4 GHz one.

steps.name: Update router firmware
steps.instructions: Open 192.168.1.1 > System > Firmware > Check for updates.

steps.name: Check fiber cable connection
steps.instructions: Make sure the green fiber cable clicks firmly into the ONT box.

steps.name: Re-verify UPI PIN
steps.instructions: In Acme Pay, go to Bank accounts > Reset UPI PIN and verify with your debit card.

known_issues.name: Login fails after app update
known_issues.symptoms: Cannot log in after updating to 4.2; error 'session invalid' or OTP never accepted

known_issues.name: UPI payment fails
known_issues.symptoms: Payment stuck or fails with 'transaction declined'

known_issues.name: Slow internet speed
known_issues.symptoms: Speeds much lower than plan, buffering

known_issues.name: No internet connection
known_issues.symptoms: Red LOS light, no connectivity at all

known_issues.name: Wi-Fi keeps dropping
known_issues.symptoms: Devices disconnect from Wi-Fi every few minutes
